effect_description_eng:
＜Partition (Red Lv.4 & Yellow Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your own effects or by battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP until the end of their turn.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
